tasks.objective: Canonicalize the bounded apply temporary root so macOS private-path aliases do not break repository checks.
acceptanceCriteria: The temporary root resolves to its physical canonical path before repository creation.

tasks.objective: Reject resuming a failed post-fix dogfood task when retry policy is none.
acceptanceCriteria: A failed task cannot be silently re-run by the resumable runner.

tasks.objective: Preserve canonical comparison capture and deterministic failure typing.
acceptanceCriteria: Comparison failures retain their canonical failure code and bounded capture.

tasks.objective: Fix non-TTY human-decision smoke typing without weakening fail-closed behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The non-TTY smoke compiles and still proves that mutation never starts without a decision.

tasks.objective: Harden dogfood report evidence validation against incomplete or malformed records.
acceptanceCriteria: Malformed evidence is rejected while complete optional pairs remain accepted.

tasks.objective: Account for Bounded discovery usage and duration in comparison metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Bounded comparison totals include discovery cost exactly once.

tasks.objective: Require real injected human-decision evidence for non-TTY apply.
acceptanceCriteria: Non-TTY apply stops at approval_required without authenticated decision evidence.

tasks.objective: Preserve a fail-safe blank human decision in interactive apply.
acceptanceCriteria: Blank input declines apply and starts no repository mutation.

tasks.objective: Capture bounded human accept, reject, and manual-edit decisions for apply.
acceptanceCriteria: The apply command records a candidate-bound human decision before mutation.

tasks.objective: Make planner repository requirements provider-neutral across adapter boundaries.
acceptanceCriteria: Planner and coder repository requirements map consistently without provider-specific assumptions.

tasks.objective: Extend the existing dogfood smoke with failed-resume rejection coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: The existing smoke detects any re-run of a failed task under retryPolicy none.

tasks.objective: Update the existing comparison smoke to cover the discovery phase budget.
acceptanceCriteria: The smoke rejects comparison output without the canonical discovery budget.

tasks.objective: Update the existing bounded comparison smoke for the canonical comparison contract.
acceptanceCriteria: The smoke rejects non-canonical comparison runtime output.

tasks.objective: Extend the existing human-decision smoke with the non-TTY fail-closed path.
acceptanceCriteria: The smoke proves non-TTY execution creates no decision artifact and starts no mutation.

tasks.objective: Extend the existing auth preflight smoke with default Codex home propagation coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: The smoke detects loss of the resolved default Codex home between live steps.

tasks.objective: Align dogfood outer and child timeouts with canonical runtime phase budgets.
acceptanceCriteria: Runner and smoke agree on an outer timeout that cannot expire before canonical phase budgets.

tasks.objective: Bind AG1B verification to deterministic artifact maintenance across existing product files.
acceptanceCriteria: AG1B artifact maintenance and both deterministic verifiers agree on the same evidence.

tasks.objective: Restore live Codex scope discovery compatibility across command, provider, contract, and smoke.
acceptanceCriteria: Live discovery accepts the canonical provider response while malformed responses remain fail-closed.

tasks.objective: Integrate Codex crash recovery with canonical durable task state across existing files.
acceptanceCriteria: A terminal resumed run reuses canonical durable state without replaying the provider.

tasks.objective: Record and balance comparison execution order across command, runner, and smoke.
acceptanceCriteria: Comparison artifacts record the actual arm order and cover both balanced orders.
